explanation: The holy building in Jerusalem that was the center of Jewish worship, but which Jesus prophesied would be completely destroyed, with not one stone left upon another.
Events or occurrences that indicate something greater is coming, especially the cosmic and earthly events that mark the end times.
Conflicts between nations and kingdoms that Jesus warned would arise before the final conclusion comes.
Impostors who claim to be the Savior but lead people away from the truth by performing great signs to deceive believers.
The suffering and threats disciples will face from authorities and family because they confess their faith in Jesus.
The concept of the holy pact or agreement between God and His people, here symbolizing God's presence in the Temple before its destruction.
The help and support believers must give one another during difficult times, even when they are being persecuted.
One of the great cosmic signs signaling that world order is about to change fundamentally before God's judgment comes.
A title Jesus uses for himself, drawn from the book of Daniel, to describe his role as the divine judge and savior who will come on the clouds.
A key word in the chapter that urges the disciples to be alert, ready, and faithful while they wait for God's kingdom.
